summary: Lumen Technologies filed an 8-K providing updated unaudited pro forma financial information for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, in connection with its S-4 registration. The update supersedes prior pro forma data related to the previously closed sale of its Mass Markets fiber-to-the-home business in multiple states. The sale closed for cash consideration of $5.75 billion, reduced by ~$30 million in adjustments, yielding pre-tax proceeds of ~$5.72 billion. Proceeds were used to redeem secured notes and repay term loans. This filing is a supplementary disclosure, not a new event; the divestiture event was previously reported.
